full_judgment: 10. One other fact as to the knowledge of Defendant No. 7 might have been noticed for the purpose of disposal of the Order 9 proceeding. In the First Appeal which was filed in the High Court against the decree made in the Partition Suit Defendant No. 7 was also a party as Respondent No. 7. There is a presumption that the official acts were regularly done and therefore it could have been very well presumed that Respondent No. 7 of the said appeal received the notice of the said appeal also, and was thereby fastened with the knowledge of the decree made in the said partition suit.
